author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: A V of hammock fabric hangs from a ceiling bar and holds the hips; the person hangs upside down with a bent leg hooked over, arms reaching down and head at the bottom. Reads as an inverted person in a hammock (the old version read as goal posts).
omissions: Reference's outlined trapezoid fabric and outlined limbs reduced to a ceiling bar, a V sling and stick limbs; the second leg overlaps the first.
